description: Send (and optionally receive) from your own domain instead of @getcourier.dev, so your sending reputation is your own. Needs an account with credits. Returns the DNS records to publish: 3 DKIM CNAMEs, a MAIL FROM MX + SPF, a DMARC suggestion, and an inbound MX if you also want to receive. Use a dedicated subdomain such as agents.yourcompany.com. Next: publish the DNS records it returns, then call domain_status until status is verified.

account_key.description: The account_key returned by create_account (or send it as Authorization: Bearer).

domain.description: The domain or subdomain you control, e.g. agents.example.com.

name: add_domain
title: Add your own domain
